Name: SVE Lance Dialogue Expansion (EN Translation)
Author: foureyedface
Description:
This is an English translation of maixine0725's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23309?tab=description]Lance Dialogue Expansion mod[/url]. This is my first translation project, and the Chinese as maxine0725 themselves noted, was colloquial and a bit difficult to translate at times. I did my best, and made very slight modifications to fit a western, english speaking audience. But the meaning should still be the same and convey the same in both languages. If you disagree with any translations I made, please let me know and I will review it. But I ask you be kind.

I don't think any of the code should be messed up, but if it is please let me know. I briefly tested it and everything seems to be running fine. But if there's any issues feel free to let me know and I will look into it. If there are any typos or grammatical errors, please feel free to let me know.

[b]English translation of maxine0725's description:[/b]

[quote][b]Added and modified about 300 lines of daily dialogue for Lance from SVE, letting him talk a bit more.[/b]
This mods and adds daily dialogue for Lance both before and after marriage. I really like the Lance's character, but I always felt that talking to him could feel a bit difficult (in a positive way). He often talks about adventures and monsters, which makes him feel a bit disconnected from Pelican Town and the farmer. To change this, I’ve modified and added lots of dialogue for him.

[b]Main modifications and additions are as follows:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][b]Casual Conversations[/b]
Both pre-marriage and post-marriage daily dialogue. I've added lots of casual conversations, such as greetings about the current season, weather, and the farmer's work. He also mentions some of the residents of Pelican Town. So he will spend more time focusing on Pelican Town and the farmer.

[*][b]Affection Dialogue[/b]
As his affection increases, his casual conversations gradually become more ambiguous as his feelings grow for the farmer and focuses more on them. Although in my dialogue, he never mentions the farmer's gender, I wrote in an otome-like style, so please keep that in mind.

[i]Note: It’s recommended to install this mod when Lance has 0 hearts, or you may miss a lot of the new daily dialogue.[/i]

[*][b]Slightly Modified Personality[/b]
I've made him more talkative and a bit clingy. At first, he's like a protective older brother. But as his affection increases, he starts to show possessiveness. Generally, he is an experienced and powerful warrior who is cold and ruthless in battle, but he tries to avoid showing this dangerous side in front of the townspeople and the farmer. He also struggles to adapt to the peaceful life of Pelican Town. In some cases, he will reveal his adventurer side, giving off a dangerous vibe.
Since I didn’t modify the heart events, the changes in his personality isn’t too dramatic. You can think of it as him adopting a different attitude in everyday life compared to when he's with the Adventurer’s Guild. If you mind this, then this mod might not be suitable for you.

[*][b]Farmer’s Attitude[/b]
I tried to write the dialogues with a “two-person conversation” approach, so the farmer may come across as a bit more talkative and playful.

[*][b]Lance’s Attitude[/b]
In this mod, Lance likes the farmer from the start and has a lot of enthusiasm and affection for them. If you only want to be friends with him, this mod might not be suitable for you.

[/list][b]Recommended Portrait:[/b]
[url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23256]Lance Portrait - New Hair[/url]
[i]Edit: I’m a bit scared of being criticized, so I’ve hidden this portrait mod for now. If any Chinese players want it, feel free to contact me on Xiaohongshu [/i](T/N: may be called RedNote in the west)[i] and I can send it to you.[/i]
This is just a portrait I drew myself, you can use any other portrait mod you like.

[b]Important Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]No redistribution or re-uploading is allowed. This mod is released for free on Nexus Mods. If you’ve paid for it or obtained it from other sources, you’ve been scammed.
[*]I’m not very skilled in programming, and I made this mod in about one day with pure effort. I tested it briefly, and it seems to work fine loading and displaying correctly. If you encounter any issues during gameplay feel free to let me know, and I’ll try to solve it. But I can’t guarantee I can fix everything.
[*](Please kindly forgive any typos, thank you!)
[/list][b]If you want to translate this mod, just let me know.[/b]
This mod is written in a colloquial style that fits casual Chinese speaking habits. It’s very casual, and machine translators may not capture it well, so it could be difficult to translate properly.
[b]Contact:[/b]
You can leave a comment here or contact me on Xiaohongshu (RedNote): ID 4237858163
[b]Installation Instructions:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install Content Patcher first

[*]Simply put the mod folder into the Mods folder

[*]If you want to delete it, just delete the mod folder, and it won’t affect anything

[/list]Thank you everyone, hope you like it~~[/quote]
